metas.name: Enemy
metas.description:
Two men turn out to be observably identical. A Toronto history professor finds an actor who is his exact double — same face, scar and voice — and no measurement he can run separates them, so the film lets the ambiguity stay open.

A mild-mannered college professor investigates the life of an actor who looks exactly like him.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description:
Nested causal chains run in parallel here. Two engineers build a time machine in a garage, copies of the same people multiply across loops, and who is observing whom keeps flipping depending on which loop you are in.

Four friends/fledgling entrepreneurs, knowing that there's something bigger and more innovative than the different error-checking devices they've built, wrestle over their new invention.

metas.name: Predestination
metas.description:
The premise is a closed loop in which a self is its own cause. A time-travelling agent on one last assignment is caught in a cycle that lands on the autonomy paradox: if the self seeking freedom was produced by the structure, what would escaping be for that self?

As his last assignment, a temporal agent is tasked to travel back in time and prevent a bomb attack in New York in 1975. The hunt, however, turns out to be beyond the bounds of possibility.

metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description:
Everything that passes through the Shimmer comes out refracted. A team enters it, where light, radio, DNA and memory are mixed across channels like a signal through a prism — plants shaped like people, animals carrying other species' traits.

A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition in which the laws of nature don't apply.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description:
Society is coming apart at street level. In 2027, after 18 years of human infertility, a burned-out bureaucrat must get one pregnant woman across a collapsing Britain of refugee camps and long-take ambushes.

In 2027, in a chaotic world in which women have somehow become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea.

metas.name: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
metas.description:
The ship at the centre is a complete working system. During the Napoleonic Wars a British frigate hunts a French ship around South America — seamanship, weather and hierarchy, and a captain whose naturalist friend would rather be cataloguing species in the Galápagos.

During the Napoleonic Wars, a brash British captain pushes his ship and crew to their limits in pursuit of a formidable French war vessel around South America.

metas.name: Sorcerer
metas.description:
Pure physical tension is the whole engine here. Four fugitives in South America take the only job out — hauling unstable nitroglycerin in old trucks through jungle — centred on getting a truck across a rotting rope bridge in a storm, in real time.

Four unfortunate men from different parts of the globe agree to risk their lives transporting gallons of nitroglycerin across dangerous Latin American jungle.

metas.name: Perfect Days
metas.description:
One man's routine life, held with complete attention, is the entire subject. A Tokyo public-toilet cleaner, his cassette tapes (Lou Reed, Patti Smith, Nina Simone), trees and light — almost nothing happens, and that is the point.

Hirayama cleans public toilets in Tokyo, lives his life in simplicity and daily tranquility. Some encounters also lead him to reflect on himself.

metas.name: Aftersun
metas.description:
What a child can only half-see in a parent is this film's whole territory. An 11-year-old on a cheap package holiday in Turkey with her young dad, partly on wobbly camcorder, intercut with herself at 31 trying to remember it — he is funny and present, and clearly drowning in something.

Sophie reflects on the shared joy and private melancholy of a holiday she took with her father twenty years earlier. Memories real and imagined fill the gaps between as she tries to reconcile the father she knew with the man she d...

metas.name: Past Lives
metas.description:
This is the life that didn't happen, with nobody in the wrong. Childhood sweethearts from Seoul reconnect in New York 24 years later — she is happily married — and have kind, adult conversations about the road not taken.

Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Twenty years later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront notions of love and destiny.

metas.name: Shoplifters
metas.description:
The household at its centre is a family and a crime at once. A poor Tokyo family who shoplift to get by take in a neglected little girl; shared croquettes and a beach day sit alongside the question of what they actually are to each other.

On the margins of Tokyo, a dysfunctional band of outsiders are united by loyalty, a penchant for petty theft and playful grifting. When the young son is arrested, secrets are exposed that upend their tenuous, below-the-radar exist...

metas.name: Manchester by the Sea
metas.description:
Grief here gets no redemption arc. A janitor who exiled himself after an unforgivable mistake must return home to look after his teenage nephew, and cannot accept the forgiveness he is offered.

A depressed uncle is asked to take care of his teenage nephew after the boy's father dies.

metas.name: Whiplash
metas.description:
Ambition becomes a kind of self-violence. A jazz drummer practises until his hands bleed under a teacher who terrorises him, and the final scene shows the exact moment he chooses greatness anyway, without resolving whether it was worth it.

A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

metas.name: A Separation
metas.description:
In this fight, everyone is partly right. In Tehran a couple separate over leaving Iran versus staying for a father with Alzheimer's; a carer is hired, something happens off-camera, and every version of events is incomplete.

A married couple have to decide whether to improve their daughter's life by moving abroad or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent with Alzheimer's disease.

metas.name: La Haine
metas.description:
The anger here has nowhere to go for a full day. Black-and-white, 24 hours in a Paris banlieue after a riot: three friends, one lost police revolver, a lot of waiting and joking, under its recurring falling-man line — 'so far, so good.'

24 hours in the lives of three young men in the French suburbs the day after a violent riot.

metas.name: Ikiru
metas.description:
A man realises his life has been wasted, and does one real thing. A Tokyo bureaucrat who stamped papers for 30 years, given a terminal diagnosis, spends his last months forcing one small park through the same bureaucracy.

An aging Tokyo bureaucrat, shaken by a grave diagnosis, breaks from his hollow routine and searches for meaning, connection, and one worthwhile act.

metas.name: Bicycle Thieves
metas.description:
Poverty becomes shame, lived out in front of your child. A man finally gets work, his bike is stolen on day one, and he and his small son walk Rome searching for it — nothing else, and it is enough.

In post-war Italy, a working-class man's bicycle is stolen, endangering his efforts to find work. He and his son set out to find it.

metas.name: Tokyo Story
metas.description:
Children drift from their parents, and everyone is too polite to say it hurts. Elderly parents visit Tokyo, are gently passed around by their busy children, and go home.

An old couple visit their children and grandchildren in the city, but receive little attention.

metas.name: The Straight Story
metas.description:
The film plays its story with total sincerity and zero irony. An old man who cannot drive a car rides a lawnmower tractor across two states to see his estranged, dying brother — David Lynch's gentlest film.

Alvin Straight, a 73-year-old, learns that his estranged brother, Lyle is critically ill. Unable to drive, Alvin embarks on a journey from Iowa to Mt. Zion by riding a lawn mower.

metas.name: Paterson
metas.description:
One man's routine becomes a work of art. One week with a bus driver named Paterson, in Paterson, who writes poems about matchboxes and waterfalls between shifts.

A quiet observation of the triumphs and defeats of daily life, along with the poetry evident in its smallest details.

metas.name: Columbus
metas.description:
Two people keep each other company inside their own stalled grief. A son stuck in Indiana while his father is in a coma meets a young woman who loves the town's modernist buildings and cannot leave her mother.

A Korean-born man finds himself stuck in Columbus, Indiana, where his architect father is in a coma. The man meets a young woman who wants to stay in Columbus with her mother, a recovering addict, instead of pursuing her own dreams.

metas.name: Boyhood
metas.description:
Time itself is the subject. Shot with the same actors over 12 real years, so the kid actually grows up on screen; the plot is just childhood happening.

The life of Mason, from early childhood to his arrival at college.

metas.name: Before Sunrise
metas.description:
Love arrives here through conversation alone. Two strangers on a train spend one night walking and talking in Vienna until a morning flight.

A young man and woman meet on a train in Europe, and wind up spending one evening together in Vienna. Unfortunately, both know that this will probably be their only night together.

metas.name: In the Mood for Love
metas.description:
Longing, held back on purpose, is the entire method. Two neighbours in 1960s Hong Kong learn their spouses are cheating with each other, fall for each other, and refuse to do the same thing.

Two neighbors form a strong bond after both suspect extramarital activities of their spouses. However, they agree to keep their bond platonic so as not to commit similar wrongs.

metas.name: Scenes from a Marriage
metas.description:
A marriage gets taken apart in dialogue. A couple first interviewed as 'ideal' are revisited over years of separation, affairs, and still needing each other.

Chronicles the many years of love and turmoil that bind Marianne and Johan through matrimony, infidelity, divorce, and subsequent partners.

metas.name: Blue Valentine
metas.description:
The film cross-cuts love decaying with love beginning. The same couple early and late, and the late scenes are unbearable precisely because the early ones were real.

A couple cannot halt the downward spiral of their marriage.

metas.name: Moonlight
metas.description:
We watch a self form under pressure, in three ages. One boy in Miami at 9, 16 and adult — bullied, desired, armoured — told almost entirely in looks and silences.

A young African-American man grapples with his identity and sexuality while experiencing the everyday struggles of childhood, adolescence, and burgeoning adulthood.

metas.name: The Battle of Algiers
metas.description:
Both insurgency and counter-insurgency unfold as procedures. Staged like newsreel, with no hero on either side, as Algiers becomes a chessboard of cells, checkpoints and bombs.

In the 1950s, fear and violence escalate as the people of Algiers fight for independence from the French government.

metas.name: Do the Right Thing
metas.description:
It all happens in one neighbourhood on the hottest day of the year. A Brooklyn block and a pizzeria wall of fame, everyone funny and aggrieved in their own direction until the heat does what heat does.

On the hottest day of the year on a street in the Bedford-Stuyvesant section of Brooklyn, everyone's hatred and bigotry smolder and build until violence erupts.

metas.name: City of God
metas.description:
For children here, violence is a career ladder. A Rio favela across two decades, narrated by a kid who wants out via a camera while his peers climb by killing.

In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge as one struggles to become a photographer and the other a kingpin.

metas.name: A Prophet
metas.description:
What the film follows is an education in power. A young illiterate man enters a French prison with nothing and learns languages, networks, violence and patience, scene by scene, until the hierarchy is his.

A delinquent Muslim man struggles to get by in prison until he is taken under the wing of a powerful mob boss, but his gradual rise through the organization's ranks brings him in conflict with his mentor.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description:
The investigators fail — for real, not as a plot device. South Korea's first serial murder case, 1986: local cops who beat confessions out of people, a Seoul detective who trusts evidence, and a country equipped for neither to work.

In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: Harakiri
metas.description:
An honour code reveals itself as bureaucratic cruelty. A penniless samurai asks to die at a clan house; the story he tells, and the one they tell back, dismantle the whole code — a courtroom film with swords.

When a ronin requesting seppuku at a feudal lord's palace is told of the brutal suicide of another ronin who previously visited, he reveals how their pasts are intertwined - and in doing so challenges the clan's integrity.

metas.name: Come and See
metas.description:
This is war as it is done to a child. Belarus, 1943: a boy joins the partisans beaming and ages a lifetime in days; it is not the gore, it is his face.

After finding a rifle, a Belarusian teenager joins Soviet partisans in World War II and is swept into the harrowing realities of Nazi occupation.

metas.name: Possession
metas.description:
A marriage breaks down as literal hysteria. A couple in Berlin tearing each other apart, in Isabelle Adjani's unhinged performance — domestic, then completely not.

A woman starts exhibiting increasingly disturbing behavior after asking her husband for a divorce. Suspicions of infidelity soon give way to something much more sinister.

metas.name: Uncut Gems
metas.description:
Gambling mania becomes perpetual motion. A New York jeweller owes everyone and keeps placing the next bet to fix the last one; the film never lets him or you breathe for two hours.

With his debts mounting and angry collectors closing in, a fast-talking New York City jeweler risks everything in hope of staying afloat and alive.

metas.name: Persona
metas.description:
It begins from a simple imbalance: one person has stopped speaking and the other can't stop. A mute actress, her nurse, a summer house, and the boundary between them getting porous.

A nurse is put in charge of a mute actress and finds that their personae are melding together.

metas.name: Stalker
metas.description:
The subject is wanting something you are afraid to actually receive. A guide leads a writer and a scientist into a forbidden Zone toward a room said to grant your innermost wish; very slow, and the slowness is the point.

A guide leads two men through an area known as the Zone to find a room that grants wishes.

metas.name: Synecdoche, New York
metas.description:
A life tries to represent itself honestly, and drowns in the attempt. A theatre director builds a scale copy of his city inside a warehouse and keeps casting people to play people, including himself, for decades.

A theater director struggles with his work and the women in his life as he creates a life-size replica of New York City inside a warehouse as part of his new play.

metas.name: Grey Gardens
metas.description:
A mother and daughter live fused together in a decaying mansion. The Beales, relatives of Jackie Kennedy, singing, bickering and feeding raccoons in the attic — performing for the camera and trapped with each other.

Meet a mother and daughter, high-society dropouts, reclusive cousins of Jackie O., managing to thrive together amid the decay and disorder of their East Hampton, NY, mansion, making for an eerily ramshackle echo of the American Ca...

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description:
War is two children slowly running out of everything. A brother tries to keep his little sister fed and cheerful in Kobe, 1945, making worse decisions out of pride.

A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

metas.name: Waltz with Bashir
metas.description:
A soldier's memory has a hole in it, and the film circles it. Animated interviews as the director tries to recover what he did in Beirut in 1982, ending with footage that breaks the animation open.

An Israeli film director interviews fellow veterans of the 1982 invasion of Lebanon to reconstruct his own memories of his term of service in that conflict.

metas.name: Flee
metas.description:
A hidden life story gets told for the first time. An animated documentary about a refugee from Afghanistan settled in Denmark, recounting flight, family separation and a secret he has kept from everyone.

A man looks back over his life as he grapples with a painful secret he has kept hidden for 20 years, one that threatens to derail the life he has built for himself and his soon to be husband.

metas.name: Network
metas.description:
Television discovers that a breakdown is better content than news. A news anchor unravels on air, ratings rise, and the network builds a show around it; written in 1976, it describes now.

A television network cynically exploits a deranged former anchor's ravings and revelations about mass media for its own profit, but finds that his message may be difficult to control.

metas.name: The Death of Stalin
metas.description:
Absolute power turns out to be petty, terrified men improvising. Stalin drops dead and his inner circle plot, flatter and panic in the same breath — very funny, and people keep being shot between jokes.

Moscow, 1953. After being in power for nearly 30 years, Soviet dictator, Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin, takes ill and quickly dies. Now the members of the Council of Ministers scramble for power.

metas.name: Withnail and I
metas.description:
The end of youth arrives as squalor and one great friendship rotting. Two out-of-work actors in 1969 London, a disastrous country holiday, and one of them beginning to leave the other behind.

Two sloppy actors spend a weekend holiday at an uncle's country cottage.

metas.name: Election
metas.description:
At a high school, ambition runs so pure it becomes frightening. A student election, a teacher who decides one candidate must be stopped, and everyone's voiceover giving their self-justifying version.

A high school teacher meets his match in an over-achieving student politician.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description:
Acquisition becomes a religion with one worshipper. An oil prospector buys land, builds derricks, adopts a son as a prop, spars with a preacher, and hollows out in proportion to his success.

A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector in the early days of the business.

metas.name: Heat
metas.description:
Professionalism is a whole identity here, on both sides of the law. A robber and a detective each incapable of a life outside the work, recognising themselves in each other over coffee.

A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist.

metas.name: The Social Network
metas.description:
The creation myth is told as a betrayal. Facebook's founding at pure dialogue velocity — dorm rooms, depositions, and a friendship converted into equity.

As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook, he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea and by the co-founder who was later squeezed out of the business.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description:
An older moral world realises it no longer applies. A man finds drug money, a killer flips coins, and a sheriff narrates his own obsolescence; it goes quiet exactly where other thrillers go loud.

Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: Killer of Sheep
metas.description:
Working-class exhaustion settles in as a numbness in the body. A slaughterhouse worker in Watts, his kids and wife, a car engine that keeps falling out — almost no plot, made for almost no money.

Set in the Watts area of Los Angeles, a slaughterhouse worker must suspend his emotions to continue working at a job he finds repugnant, and then he finds he has little sensitivity for the family he works so hard to support.

metas.name: Jeanne Dielman, 23 quai du commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
metas.description:
A domestic routine is rendered so exactly that you feel it crack. A widow's day — bath, potatoes, clients — filmed at near real duration for 201 minutes, until one small deviation changes the temperature of everything.

A lonely widowed housewife does her daily chores, takes care of her apartment where she lives with her teenage son, and turns the occasional trick to make ends meet, but something happens that changes her safe routine.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description:
Religious paranoia eats a family from inside its own beliefs. Puritan settlers exiled to a forest's edge: a crop fails, a baby vanishes, and their theology gives them only one interpretation.

An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: Lake Mungo
metas.description:
Grief takes the form of a family documentary. Found footage, but the subject is not the ghost — it is parents and a brother in interviews, months after a drowning, still looking for anything.

Strange things start happening after a girl is found drowned in a lake.

metas.name: Safe
metas.description:
A suburban life turns out so empty that a woman becomes allergic to modernity itself. In perfect pastel houses, symptoms no doctor can find, and a drift toward a desert self-help commune.

An affluent and unexceptional homemaker in the suburbs develops multiple chemical sensitivity.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description:
In this family, grief and resentment were already there before anything supernatural arrived. A grandmother dies, a mother builds miniature scenes of her life, and a dinner-table argument is the scariest sequence.

A grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences.

metas.name: Barry Lyndon
metas.description:
The rise and fall is narrated like fate that already happened. An Irish opportunist climbs 18th-century society through duels, war and marriage, shot like paintings, with a narrator who keeps telling you the ending early.

An Irish rogue wins the heart of a rich widow and assumes her dead husband's aristocratic position in 18th-century England.

metas.name: Lawrence of Arabia
metas.description:
A man invents himself at desert scale. Nearly four hours: the landscape is a character, and so is the gap between the legend being built and the person inside it.

The story of T.E. Lawrence, the English officer who successfully united and led the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes during World War I in order to fight the Turks.

metas.name: A Brighter Summer Day
metas.description:
Adolescence unfolds inside a whole society holding its breath. Taipei, 1960 — exiled mainland families, street gangs, Elvis, a famous murder case — four hours that build a world rather than a plot.

Based on a true story, primarily on a conflict between two youth gangs, a 14-year-old boy's girlfriend conflicts with the head of one gang for an unclear reason, until finally the conflict comes to a violent climax.

metas.name: Sátántangó
metas.description:
On a collapsing Hungarian collective farm, stagnation is the weather. Seven and a half hours — rain, mud, a conman returning, long shots of people walking — where duration itself does the work.

On the eve of a large payment, residents of a collapsing collective farm see their plans turn into desolation when they discover that Irimiás, a former co-worker who they thought was dead, is returning to the community.

metas.name: Yi Yi
metas.description:
Every age of a family sees only one side of life here. Taipei, three hours, a wedding at the start and a funeral at the end — including a little son photographing the backs of people's heads so they can see what they can't.

Portrait of a middle-class family in Taipei. A man in his forties, his teenage daughter and his eight-year-old son experience life, navigating between remorse, hope and disappointment.

metas.name: Nobody Knows
metas.description:
Children keep a household going after the adults vanish. Four kids alone in a Tokyo apartment, the eldest rationing money and hiding it from the landlord, seasons passing in small changes.

In a small Tokyo apartment, twelve-year-old Akira must care for his younger siblings after their mother leaves them and shows no sign of returning.

metas.name: Amour
metas.description:
Marriage, at the point where love becomes physical care, fills this film. An elderly Paris couple, a stroke, a promise not to go back to hospital, one apartment — no softening, and tender anyway.

Georges and Anne are an octogenarian couple. They are cultivated, retired music teachers. Their daughter, also a musician, lives in Britain with her family. One day, Anne has a stroke, and the couple's bond of love is severely tes...

metas.name: Close
metas.description:
Two boys' intimacy is put on display here, and the film watches what being seen does to it. Best friends at 13, inseparable all summer, then school starts and other kids ask what they are.

The intense friendship between two thirteen-year old boys Leo and Remi suddenly gets disrupted. Struggling to understand what has happened, Léo approaches Sophie, Rémi's mother. "Close" is a film about friendship and responsibility.

metas.name: The Spirit of the Beehive
metas.description:
Inside a silenced country, a child's imagination goes to work. Post-civil-war Spain: a travelling cinema shows Frankenstein, and a solemn little girl goes looking for the monster in fields and empty houses.

In 1940, after watching and being traumatized by the movie Frankenstein (1931), a sensitive seven-year-old girl living in a small Spanish village drifts into her own fantasy world.

metas.name: Ratcatcher
metas.description:
Childhood unfolds in a Glasgow housing scheme during a garbage strike. Rats in the canals, a boy carrying a secret about a death, and moments of release on a bus out to a half-built new estate.

A naïve young lad navigates the dirty squalid streets of 1973 Glasgow and the poor youth around him.

metas.name: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
metas.description:
Desire here is the act of looking carefully. Brittany, 1770: a painter commissioned to paint a bride-to-be in secret, because the woman refuses to sit for the portrait that will be sent to her future husband.

On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

metas.name: Carol
metas.description:
In 1950s New York, desire has to stay restrained in a world with everything to lose. A shopgirl and an older woman in a custody fight — glances across a toy counter, a road trip, composure in every public room.

An aspiring photographer develops an intimate relationship with an older woman in 1950s New York.

metas.name: Happy Together
metas.description:
'Let's start over,' two men keep saying to each other — and mean it every time. Two Hong Kong men in Buenos Aires, breaking up and reuniting in cycles, with the Iguazu Falls as the place they never quite reach together.

A couple take a trip to Argentina but both men find their lives drifting apart in opposite directions.

metas.name: Call Me by Your Name
metas.description:
First desire becomes a summer education of the senses. Italy, 1983 — peaches, swimming, an older grad student in the house — and a father's talk near the end that reframes the whole film.

In the summer of 1983, 17-year-old Elio is spending the days with his family at their villa in Lombardy, Italy. He soon meets 24-year-old Oliver, an intern working for Elio's father. They discover the heady beauty of awakening des...

metas.name: The Remains of the Day
metas.description:
An English butler has spent a life not saying the thing. He gave everything to duty; after the war he drives to visit the housekeeper he loved, composing each sentence too late.

A butler sacrifices love for duty in 1930s England.

metas.name: Chungking Express
metas.description:
City loneliness moves at pop speed through Hong Kong. Two lovesick cops, expired pineapple cans, and a snack-bar girl breaking into a man's flat to clean it while 'California Dreamin'' loops.

Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious female underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal waitress at a late-night restaurant he frequents.

metas.name: Le Samouraï
metas.description:
Cool, here, is ritual and solitude. A Paris hitman in a trench coat, a grey room, a bird in a cage, an alibi arranged like furniture — almost no psychology given, all behaviour.

After professional hitman Jef Costello is seen by witnesses, his efforts to provide himself an alibi drive him further into a corner.

metas.name: Thief
metas.description:
A Chicago safecracker is trying to buy a normal life with one last job. He carries a collage of his dream life in his wallet; neon and rain, tools on metal filmed like jewellery-making.

After years in prison, ace safe-cracker Frank owns a car dealership and a cocktail lounge, which are fronts for high-stakes jewelry heists. He wants to complete one last big heist for the Mob before he goes straight.

metas.name: Dog Day Afternoon
metas.description:
One hot Brooklyn afternoon, a bank robbery turns into a live street spectacle. Pacino works the crowd outside like a rally, and the reason for the robbery arrives piece by piece.

Three amateur robbers plan to hold up a Brooklyn bank. A nice, simple robbery: Walk in, take the money, and run. Unfortunately, the supposedly uncomplicated heist suddenly becomes a bizarre nightmare as everything that could go wr...

metas.name: The Conversation
metas.description:
His job is listening, and he has finally heard something. A surveillance expert replays one taped conversation until a line changes meaning, and his own privacy obsession turns on him.

A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.

metas.name: Unforgiven
metas.description:
The western myth is dragged back by an old killer who is bad at everything now. Retired, broke and widowed, he cannot mount his horse or shoot straight, and the film insists killing is exactly as ugly as that implies.

Retired Old West gunslinger Will Munny reluctantly takes on one last job to avenge an injustice with the help of his old partner and a young would-be gunman calling himself "The Schofield Kid".

metas.name: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
metas.description:
Celebrity worship, 1882 style, drives this film. A famous outlaw ageing and paranoid, and a young admirer who memorised his life from dime novels and moves into his orbit — slow, golden, narrated like a history book.

Robert Ford, who has idolized Jesse James since childhood, tries hard to join the resurgent gang of the Missouri outlaw, but gradually becomes resentful of the bandit leader.

metas.name: Paris, Texas
metas.description:
A man tries to re-enter the family he walked out of — through glass first. A mute drifter found in the desert, a brother, a son — and a reunion in a peep-show booth where he can finally talk because he cannot be touched.

After missing for 4 years, aimless drifter Travis Henderson wanders out of the desert and slowly begins to reconnect with his brother's family and his young son while examining his past and attempting to reconcile with his estrang...

metas.name: Y Tu Mamá También
metas.description:
Youth burns brightly over a country it isn't looking at. Two teenage boys and an older woman drive to a beach that may not exist, while the narrator quietly tells you the futures and the roadside Mexico they pass.

In Mexico, two teenage boys and an older woman embark on a road trip and learn a thing or two about life and each other.

metas.name: Thelma & Louise
metas.description:
Escape becomes irreversible here, and friendship becomes absolute. A weekend trip, a parking lot, a gun — then two women driving west, getting freer and more cornered in the same scenes.

An Arkansas waitress and a housewife shoot a rapist and take off in a '66 Thunderbird.

metas.name: Meek's Cutoff
metas.description:
Being lost is shown from the women's side of the wagons. Oregon Trail settlers, a guide who may be bluffing, water running out — long shots of bonnets and horizon where the drama is thirst and waiting.

Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

metas.name: Army of Shadows
metas.description:
Resistance, in 1942 France, is cold, lonely procedure. Safe houses, coded phrases, informers executed badly — no glamour and almost no hope, filmed like a heist movie in mourning.

An account of underground resistance fighters in Nazi-occupied France.

metas.name: Paths of Glory
metas.description:
Military honour is used to cover a command failure. After a suicidal attack fails, three soldiers are chosen to be executed for cowardice to make the point, and their colonel tries law against arithmetic.

A colonel defends three of his soldiers in a court-martial after they abandon a suicidal attack.

metas.name: Apollo 13
metas.description:
Competence under constraint is the drama here. An explosion in space, and the film becomes people in rooms with slide rules solving the next physical problem before the air runs out — the opposite of lone-hero cinema.

NASA must devise a strategy to return Apollo 13 to Earth safely after the spacecraft undergoes massive internal damage putting the lives of the three astronauts on board in jeopardy.

metas.name: First Man
metas.description:
The Moon landing is seen from inside a grieving, taciturn man. Armstrong as an engineer who can land anything except in his own family's pain; the flights are rattling, cramped and procedural.

A look back at the life of astronaut Neil Armstrong and the legendary space mission that led him to become the first man to walk on the Moon on July 20, 1969.

metas.name: Princess Mononoke
metas.description:
An ecological war plays out with no pure side. Iron Town needs the forest cut to survive; the forest gods need the humans gone; a prince cursed by a dying god tries to see with unclouded eyes.

After a deadly curse forces him from home, young warrior Ashitaka journeys west and is drawn into a conflict between ancient forest spirits, an iron town, and a wolf-raised girl.

metas.name: The Wrestler
metas.description:
His body only has value inside the ring. An ageing, hearing-damaged wrestler on supermarket shifts, trying with his daughter, and finding the crowd is the one place the world still makes sense to him.

A faded professional wrestler must retire, but finds his quest for a new life outside the ring a dispiriting struggle.

metas.name: Raging Bull
metas.description:
Self-destruction plays out in a family kitchen as much as in a ring. Jake LaMotta's jealousy and violence at home filmed with the same intensity as the fights; he can take any punch except accountability.

The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

metas.name: The 400 Blows
metas.description:
A boy is processed, step by step, into a delinquent. Paris, a cramped flat, a teacher, small lies compounding into reform school — and a final run to the sea in one long take, ending on his face.

A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.

metas.name: Kes
metas.description:
A working-class kid has exactly one thing of his own. In Barnsley coal country, Billy is written off at home and school, teaches himself falconry from a library book, and a kestrel makes him articulate and gentle.

A working-class English boy spends his free time caring for and training his pet kestrel.

metas.name: Fish Tank
metas.description:
A teenage girl's anger and wanting have no room in the place she lives. An Essex estate, a 15-year-old who dances alone in empty flats, and her mum's new boyfriend who seems to actually see her.

Everything changes for 15-year-old Mia when her mum brings home a new boyfriend.

metas.name: Eighth Grade
metas.description:
Social anxiety in the age of front-facing cameras, rendered exactly. A girl filming confident advice videos she cannot follow, pool parties endured minute by minute, and a father scene near the end that rearranges parents.

An introverted teenage girl tries to survive the last week of her disastrous eighth grade year before leaving to start high school.

metas.name: Pan's Labyrinth
metas.description:
For a child in 1944 Spain, fantasy is the only available resistance. A girl with a fascist stepfather descends to a faun's tasks while the adult war continues above ground, and fantasy is never 'just' escape.

In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

metas.name: The Night of the Hunter
metas.description:
Childhood danger takes the shape of a fairy tale. A preacher with LOVE and HATE tattooed on his knuckles hunts two children down a river for hidden money; they flee by boat through a dreamlike, animal-watched night.

A self-proclaimed preacher marries a gullible widow whose young children are reluctant to tell him where their real dad hid the $10,000 he'd stolen in a robbery.

metas.name: All the President's Men
metas.description:
Journalism here is shoe leather. Watergate as phone calls, parking garages, notebooks and editors asking 'what else do you have?' — verification repeated until a presidency moves.

"The Washington Post" reporters Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein uncover the details of the Watergate scandal that leads to President Richard Nixon's resignation.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description:
An investigation becomes a team slowly realising the size of the room they're in. Boston Globe reporters, church abuse, sealed records, survivors telling it plainly — no heroics beyond persistence.

The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

metas.name: The Insider
metas.description:
Telling the truth, inside two corporations at once, comes at a cost. A tobacco scientist bound by confidentiality, a TV producer with a network to protect, and an interview everyone with money wants buried.

A research chemist comes under personal and professional attack when he decides to appear in a 60 Minutes exposé on Big Tobacco.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description:
Obsession gathers around a case that will not close. San Francisco, years of codes, files, basements and false certainties; the killer fades and the men who chased him are what's left damaged.

Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.
